data.name: Secret Magic
data.description: Merfolk sometimes manifest magical powers they are unwilling to explain to non-merfolk, leading scholars to speculate that the magic originates from the merfolk's rumored eldritch patrons. Such merfolk have only a 40-foot swim speed, but they add +1 to the DC of any enchantment spells they cast, and if they have a Charisma score of 13 or higher, they gain the ability to cast the following spell-like abilities: At will--speak with animals (aquatic animals only); 1/day--fins to feet (self only), hydraulic push. This racial trait replaces the armor racial trait and alters the merfolk's movement speed.
